criterion.name: exactness (HARD)
criterion.detail: gate 0/1800 mismatches (R1 0/1440, R2 0/360); non-vacuous via 105/105 corrupted-cached-entry controls detected (R1 90/90, R2 15/15)

criterion.name: GPU-energy neutrality of identity layer (HARD)
criterion.detail: BY CONSTRUCTION: one engine run per cell; the identifier never feeds the engine, so |J/token(hashrope) - J/token(radix)| is identically 0 (identical dispatched GPU work) and lies trivially within the 2% delta_E margin and any run-to-run band. No per-arm engine energies exist; none are fabricated. R1: cache-ON J/token 0.110 +/- 0.010 (n=9, 95% band +/- 0.022; delta_E threshold 2% = 0.002) | R2 L=131072: cache-ON J/token 22.338 +/- 0.282 (n=9, 95% band +/- 0.649; delta_E threshold 2% = 0.447) | R2 L=262144: cache-ON J/token 34.973 +/- 0.421 (n=9, 95% band +/- 0.971; delta_E threshold 2% = 0.699) | R2 L=393216: cache-ON J/token 50.102 +/- 0.911 (n=9, 95% band +/- 2.101; delta_E threshold 2% = 1.002) | R2 L=524288: cache-ON J/token 65.311 +/- 0.432 (n=9, 95% band +/- 0.997; delta_E threshold 2% = 1.306) | NOTE: absolute J/token is prefill-dominated (denominator = completion tokens); the OFF/ON ratio and delta are the meaningful quantities.

criterion.name: framework caching energy, attributed (HARD)
criterion.detail: ATTRIBUTION: the ON-OFF delta is the ENGINE's prefix-cache effect, explicitly NOT hashrope's. R1: Delta(ON-OFF) J/token -2.367 +/- 0.074 (ratio OFF/ON 22.65x +/- 1.84, n=9; sign ON<OFF 9/9, p=0.0020); Delta TTFT -35.2 ms (sign 9/9, p=0.0020) | R2 L=131072: Delta(ON-OFF) J/token -1,532.736 +/- 3.170 (ratio OFF/ON 69.63x +/- 0.84, n=9; sign ON<OFF 9/9, p=0.0020); Delta TTFT -7,532.4 ms (sign 9/9, p=0.0020) | R2 L=262144: Delta(ON-OFF) J/token -5,223.442 +/- 3.801 (ratio OFF/ON 150.38x +/- 1.75, n=9; sign ON<OFF 9/9, p=0.0020); Delta TTFT -26,158.8 ms (sign 9/9, p=0.0020) | R2 L=393216: Delta(ON-OFF) J/token -10,851.296 +/- 263.826 (ratio OFF/ON 217.57x +/- 2.58, n=9; sign ON<OFF 9/9, p=0.0020); Delta TTFT -53,936.3 ms (sign 9/9, p=0.0020) | R2 L=524288: Delta(ON-OFF) J/token -18,065.649 +/- 11.432 (ratio OFF/ON 277.62x +/- 1.88, n=9; sign ON<OFF 9/9, p=0.0020); Delta TTFT -91,587.6 ms (sign 9/9, p=0.0020) | R2 L in [1000000]: Track A SKIPPED (engine_serve_infeasible_dense_attention; 18 cells) -- no engine energy at these L by design

criterion.name: identification-cost regimes (R2 win + R1 negative)
criterion.detail: crossover L*' bracketed in (524,288, 1,000,000]: radix still faster at L=524,288, hashrope faster at L=1,000,000 (44.42 +/- 0.63 ms vs radix 53.19 +/- 3.78 ms, hashrope 1.20x faster; paired sign 9/9, p=0.0020) | hashrope identification at L=1,000,000 = 44.42 ms = 0.048% of full-prefill (cache-OFF) TTFT and 5.08% of cache-ON TTFT at L=524,288 (largest dense-servable L; conservative reference -- TTFT grows superlinearly in L, so true fractions at L=1,000,000 would be smaller) | R1 HONEST NEGATIVE (~642-token median-scale prefixes): radix 0.037 ms < hashrope 17.46 ms (flat 0.005 ms); reported in full, not the lede

criterion.name: honest negatives in full
criterion.detail: Disclosed: (a) R1 identification cost -- see clause (iv); (b) cache-ON regression check from data: R1: 0 TTFT / 0 throughput regressions (of 9 pairs); R2 L=131072: 0 TTFT / 0 throughput regressions (of 9 pairs); R2 L=262144: 0 TTFT / 0 throughput regressions (of 9 pairs); R2 L=393216: 0 TTFT / 0 throughput regressions (of 9 pairs); R2 L=524288: 0 TTFT / 0 throughput regressions (of 9 pairs); (c) (ii) neutrality is by-construction, not a measured per-arm difference; (d) conditional-on-use scope: an upstream identifier is redundant inside a single engine, valuable in multi-instance routing / cross-request dedup / opaque-blob contexts | numpy-flat is fastest at every L (0.677 ms at L=1,000,000): a C-vectorized O(L) scan with no persistence/edits/branching; the functional comparison is vs radix (the production engine matcher); hashrope's edge is the unification, not single-query LCP wall-clock

criterion.name: statistics + environment
criterion.detail: all aggregates n>=9: YES; paired sign tests computed throughout; GPU clocks recorded in 90/90 non-skipped Track A cells; env blocks (python/torch/vllm/hashrope versions, git sha, seeds) present in both grid files: YES

criterion.name: contingent per-arm end-to-end GPU win
criterion.detail: Structural: the one-engine-run-per-cell design produces no per-arm end-to-end engine metrics (TTFT/throughput/J-token per identifier arm), so the F6 precondition (paired 9/9, p<0.05, effect >= 10% on an engine metric) cannot arise. S3 stands on (i)-(vi).
